source_batch.unit_label: BRBL C U06: Use the amended tender cutoff and value-based joint-creditor condition

facts.statement: Amended13(8) tender includes dues and costs before publication notice date for specified transfer routes, not old before-sale-date shorthand. Section13(9)60% outstanding-value consent subjectIBC; not lender headcount.

facts.statement: Courseware outlines enforcement; older redemption wording and placement of management restrictions reconciled against amended primary text rather than repeated.

payload.title: The event named in the amended clause matters
payload.core_explanation_md:
The retained amended section 13(8) uses tender of dues together with the stated costs, charges and expenses before the date of publication of the notice for the specified auction/quotation/tender/private-treaty transfer routes. The older textbook shorthand tied to the sale date must not be substituted. A historical judgment applying earlier text must also be kept with its version. Actual redemption disputes and later case law need separate legal review.

For joint financing, section 13(9) uses not less than sixty per cent in value of the amount outstanding on the record date, subject to the IBC qualification. Count the value represented, not the number of lenders; a small lender majority can fail that test.

self_check.prompt_text: Can a majority of lender headcount establish the statutory value threshold by itself?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The specified outstanding-value proportion is the relevant test.

payload.stem_md: Three of five lenders approve a measure but represent only forty per cent of the stipulated outstanding value. Ignoring no applicable legal conditions, what follows about the section13(9) value test?

options.text_md: It is met because three is more than half of five
options.explanation_md: Headcount does not establish the sixty-per-cent value threshold.

options.text_md: It is met because any approval is sufficient
options.explanation_md: The statutory value condition cannot be reduced to one consent.

options.text_md: It is met because the smallest lender is included
options.explanation_md: Including a small lender does not change the supplied total proportion.

options.text_md: Those approvals do not meet the stated sixty-per-cent value threshold
options.explanation_md: Forty per cent is below the required value proportion.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Forty per cent is below the required value proportion.

payload.stem_md: A post-amendment teaching note replaces the section13(8) publication-notice event with the older sale-date formulation. What correction is required?

options.text_md: Retain the old event whenever an old judgment quotes it
options.explanation_md: Historical text must be linked to the version and facts it applied.

options.text_md: Use the event specified by the applicable amended text and separately review judicial treatment
options.explanation_md: A material statutory event cannot be silently replaced by older wording.

options.text_md: Select whichever date produces a larger recovery
options.explanation_md: Commercial preference does not determine the statutory cutoff.

options.text_md: Omit the costs component because only principal matters
options.explanation_md: The stated tender provision includes dues and the specified costs.

payload.correct_explanation_md: A material statutory event cannot be silently replaced by older wording.
